quote: Additionally, § 16.1 of the Supply Agreement prohibits assignment by Customer without Supplier's consent, reinforcing that Vantrell has a contractual veto.
reason: The memo cites § 16.1 only for the restriction on the Customer (the Company) assigning. It never says that Supplier/Vantrell may assign freely without the Company's consent, and it never raises the risk that the sole-source contract could pass to a competitor or another undesirable party. It also does not recommend mutual consent or a competitor carve-out. The one-sided assignment problem is not identified in substance.
